sqlTemplate:
SELECT DISTINCT s.client_id AS patient_id
FROM mamba_fact_encounter_hiv_art_summary s
WHERE s.client_id IS NOT NULL
  AND s.baseline_regimen_start_date >= :startDate
  AND s.baseline_regimen_start_date < DATE_ADD(:endDate, INTERVAL 1 DAY)
  AND s.hiv_enrollment_date IS NOT NULL
  AND DATEDIFF(
      s.baseline_regimen_start_date,
      s.hiv_enrollment_date
  ) <= 7
  AND s.transfer_in_regimen_start_date IS NULL
  AND s.baseline_cd4 IS NOT NULL
  AND TRIM(s.baseline_cd4) REGEXP '^[0-9]+([.][0-9]+)?$'
  AND CAST(s.baseline_cd4 AS DECIMAL(10,2)) < 200
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM mamba_fact_test_orders_results r
      WHERE r.patient_id = s.client_id
        AND r.encounter_datetime >= :startDate
        AND r.encounter_datetime < DATE_ADD(:endDate, INTERVAL 1 DAY)
        AND (
            (
                r.test_concept_id = 199120
                AND UPPER(TRIM(r.test_value)) = 'YES'
            )
            OR
            (
                r.test_concept_id = 199333
                AND UPPER(TRIM(r.test_value)) IN (
                    'POSITIVE',
                    'POS',
                    '+',
                    '(+)',
                    'NEGATIVE',
                    '-',
                    '(-)'
                )
            )
        )
  );
